description: This line plot illustrates the relative performance change across different layers of the Mistral-7B-v0.2-Instruct model after applying Layer-Wise Quantized Pruning with the SnapKV method, under a KV cache budget of 1/64. The x-axis, labeled "Layer", is linear and spans from "Layer1-4" to "Layer29-32", representing the model's layers in four sequential groups. The y-axis, labeled "Relative Change", is linear and ranges from -25% to 5%, indicating the percentage deviation in performance relative to a baseline. The plot displays five distinct lines: a dashed gray line representing the "Baseline of 4×tokens,4-bit"; a solid orange line for "LB-Avg of 2×tokens,8-bit"; a solid red line for "LB-Avg of 1×tokens,16-bit"; a solid cyan line for "RULER4k of 2×tokens,8-bit"; and a solid blue line for "RULER4k of 1×tokens,16-bit". All lines begin near 0% relative change at Layer1-4, with the cyan and blue lines dipping to approximately -15% and -25% respectively at Layer13-20, before rising again toward 0% at Layer29-32. The orange and red lines remain relatively flat and close to 0% throughout the entire range.
